---
id: vuln-novnc-ad941fad
languages:
  - javascript
pattern: |
  (WebUtil\.createCookie\(\s*name\s*,\s*value\s*,\s*days\s*\)\s*{)
    \s*(var date, expires;)
    \s*(if \(days\) \{)
      \s*(date = new Date();)
      \s*(date\.setTime\(date\.getTime\(\)+(days\s*24\s*60\s*60\s*1000)\);)
      \s*(expires = "; expires="+date\.toGMTString();)
    \s*(else \{)
      \s*(expires = "";)
    \s*(document\.cookie = name+"="+value+expires+"; path=/";)
  (})
message: |
  Vulnerable code detected. The createCookie function does not set the secure flag when using HTTPS, which allows an attacker to intercept and modify the cookie value.
severity: ERROR
metadata:
  cwe: CWE-310
  cvss_score: 7.5
  cvss_vector: "CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H"
